name: Lyssn
short_description: AI-powered therapy quality and fidelity measurement platform that uses NLP to analyze sessions, provide feedback on evidence-based practices, and generate clinical documentation.
long_description: Lyssn is an AI-powered platform that transforms how behavioral health organizations measure and improve therapeutic quality. Built on 17+ years of academic research and validated by 60+ peer-reviewed publications, Lyssn uses natural language processing to analyze session recordings, transcribe sessions, and provide comprehensive evaluations of fidelity to evidence-based practices. The platform offers 75+ metrics covering empathy, active listening, and adherence to CBT, DBT, Motivational Interviewing, Suicide Prevention, Acceptance & Commitment Therapy, and Trauma-Informed Care. Lyssn automates the labor-intensive work of reviewing session recordings, providing objective fidelity scores, flagging missed opportunities, and highlighting specific dialogue for supervisor review. The platform has analyzed over 4.3 million real-world sessions and is currently conducting NIMH-funded clinical trials (Project AFFECT) evaluating AI-based CBT fidelity feedback.
one_liner: AI-powered therapy quality measurement with 75+ metrics for evidence-based practice fidelity.
best_for: Community mental health agencies implementing evidence-based practices
